headline: EU proposes sweeping new Russia sanctions

sources: The Kyiv Independent via zot.news https://zot.news/article/eu-proposes-sweeping-new-russia-sanctions-targeting-oil-646ha ; newsukrain https://newsukrain.com/world/eu-slaps-new-russia-energy-sanctions-in-response-to-trump
fault_line: Sanctions pressure or the diesel deal wins — is Europe punishing Russia while Washington buys its fuel?

sections.what_happened: EEAS presented draft sanctions to EU ambassadors Oct 21 (seen by The Kyiv Independent): 117 additional listings (12 individuals, 105 entities) targeting Russian oil refining/export (31 listings St. Petersburg to Sakhalin), 52 banking/financial institutions, 2 LNG-processing entities, the shadow fleet, and a Donetsk steel company. Irish Council Presidency spokesperson confirmed the draft. Kaja Kallas: 'we have to pressure the aggressor to stop the war, not the victim to surrender.' EU leaders had condemned the diesel deal at their Oct 15-16 Brussels summit. Draft stage — NOT yet adopted. von der Leyen at Oct 21 EP session: no sanctions lifted until war ends; no return to Russian gas purchases.
sections.what_verified: Irish Council Presidency confirmation (Kyiv Independent); Kallas on-record quote.
sections.what_disputed: Draft not adopted; EU Council unanimity required. Counterproposal in circulation: US reportedly proposing Russia resume gas flows to Europe (unverified, second-hand via The Economist — separate record).
sections.why_matters: The sanctions split: Brussels loads 117 new listings while Washington's first Russian diesel tanker sails to New York — the transatlantic contradiction.
sections.context: Background: EU proposes sweeping new Russia sanctions — 117 listings targeting refining/export, 52 banks, shadow fleet (EEAS draft)

totw_analysis: Our read: The sanctions split: Brussels loads 117 new listings while Washington's first Russian diesel tanker sails to New York — the transatlantic contradiction. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Sanctions pressure or the diesel deal wins — is Europe punishing Russia while Washington buys its fuel?
